India Begins Special Intensive Revision of Electoral Rolls

A Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls has commenced across several states in India, including Karnataka and Delhi. This process involves door-to-door verification of voters by Booth Level Officers (BLOs). Concerns have been raised about potential exclusion from welfare benefits if individuals are removed from the electoral rolls, with the Karnataka Chief Minister urging safeguards.
